messages.subject: Project Atlas - Heads of Terms (subject to contract)
messages.plaintextBody:
Charles, Miriam,

Following the call, here is where we have landed on the heads of terms. Headline enterprise value of GBP 62m, equity value GBP 54.5m after net debt of c.GBP 7.5m. Consideration split: GBP 50m cash at completion, GBP 2.5m retention in escrow for 18 months, and up to GBP 2m deferred on a FY26 EBITDA earn-out. Exclusivity to 31 January. The document is marked subject to contract save for the binding paragraphs (exclusivity, costs, confidentiality, governing law).

Grateful for any comments before we send to Harland Vesey.

James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
